A free call
Budget, move-in date, neighbourhoods, who's moving, how your income reads to a Catalan landlord. We tell you what your budget buys today.

04 — BEFORE YOU SIGN

Six things we check before you sign.

Six points we put in writing on every Barcelona contract.

I
The rent capíndice de referencia

Tensioned zone: new rents can't top the previous one, nor the reference index for large owners or homes unlet for five years.

II
Who pays the agentLAU art. 20

The landlord pays their own agent and the lease's costs. You hire us, in writing, for an optional service.

III
The depositfianza · INCASÒL

Habitual lease: one month, extra guarantees two months at most. The landlord lodges it with INCASÒL; we ask for the receipt.

IV
Contract typeLAU · Llei 11/2025

A temporary lease for work or study must state and prove its reason, and is rent-capped. Otherwise it counts as habitual.

V
Registrationpadrón · NIE

Your lease needs the full address, cadastral reference and both signatures, or the town hall refuses it.

VI
Income rulesnómina · aval

Payslips, a bank guarantee, a Spanish guarantor: each landlord asks differently. New job, foreign salary, freelance — we write it so it passes.

05 — QUESTIONS

The questions we get asked.

Isn't it the landlord who pays the agent in Spain?
Yes. Spanish law puts the costs of the landlord's agent and of the lease on the landlord, and in Catalonia passing them to the tenant is sanctioned. BOOM Barcelona is a separate, optional service you hire in writing, price shown first; it works only for you and takes nothing from landlords.
What happens on the free call?
A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call.
How do I avoid a rental scam in Barcelona from abroad?
Never pay a deposit or first rent for a home nobody on your side has seen. With Attended Viewing (€149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report. With Full Search or Application Pack we also check the contract, and that you can register on the padrón with it, before you sign.
Which service is mine?
Full Search (€500) if you haven't started. Application Pack (€199) if you've found one and need to apply, or you have a shortlist and you're already in Barcelona. Attended Viewing (€149 per viewing) if you have a shortlist and you're still abroad. Not sure: start with the free call, we advise.
Is my rent capped in Barcelona?
Barcelona is a tensioned residential zone. A new rent can't exceed the last rent of the past five years, updated; for large owners and homes not let in five years, nor the índice de referencia. Temporary leases for work or study are covered too. We check it on every search.
Do I need to be in Barcelona?
No. A BOOM person attends viewings in your place, with live video and a written report. The contract is checked and signed remotely. You arrive for the keys and the padrón.
What if you don't find anything?
We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market; if BOOM declines the search then, the €500 Full Search fee is refunded in full. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it, and the fee pays for the work, not for a result.
How do I pay?
By card on this page (Stripe) when you start; the invoice comes from Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l. Flat fees, VAT included. Order, terms and invoice in Catalan or Spanish on request. Nothing from landlords, their agents or platforms.
What do you do with my data?
Used to answer you and run your search; if you stop at the payment, we ask once whether you have questions. No resale, no mailing lists. Ask us to delete it; invoices and payment records stay, as the law requires.
